thread_text:
Samir Patel: Quick heads-up — ran a short shadow pass for a shim I prototyped (calls it a "bridgework" speculative path) against calypso-14b int8 today. Latency P95 down ~18% on short prompts (~32 tokens), cost down ~12%, but instruction-following pass rate dropped ~1.8 percentage points. Posting raw notes below.

Claire Ng: Can you paste the exact config and the metric breakouts? :eyes:

Samir Patel: Sure. Command I used:

```
./run_shadow --model calypso-14b-int8 --spec-shim topk=2 --backup=standard --batch=8 --seq=32 --holdout-file holdout/inst-2k.jsonl --out=artifacts/shadow-2026-03-21.log
```

Results (holdout, n=2000):
- PPL delta: +0.2
- Instr pass (binary rubric): baseline 89.4% -> shim 87.6%
- ROUGE-L mean: 0.416 -> 0.412
- Avg latency (ms/token): baseline 12.1 -> shim 9.9 (P50 similar, P95 improved ~18%)
- Cost per 1k tokens: -12%

Jun Park: Interesting. Do you have per-instruction-type breakdown? e.g., coding vs. open-ended vs. chain-of-thought? Could be concentrated.

Samir Patel: Yes — quick split: coding (n=500): instr pass -0.9pp, open-ended (n=800): -2.5pp, chain-of-thought (n=700): -2.0pp. So open-ended prompts took the worst hit.

Anika Bose: This smells like a diversity/beam-collapse issue on the speculative path. If shim is over-confident in top-2 it can prune creative continuations. We should: 1) run paired A/B on the 5k open-ended bench, 2) measure lexical diversity (type-token ratio), 3) audit hallucination tags.

Samir Patel: Agreed. I also saw a weird stuttering pattern in long responses (>256 tokens) where the shim would re-select a repeated token sequence after fallback; log excerpt:

```
[2026-03-21T14:12:03Z] shim: candidate_tokens=["the","the"] score_delta=0.01
[2026-03-21T14:12:03Z] backup: selected="the" fallback_count=1
[2026-03-21T14:12:04Z] shim: resent speculative bundle -> backup accepted -> kv-merge delayed
```

That delayed KV merge is probably causing a small context drift and then repetition.

Claire Ng: If it's KV merge timing, we should test two variants: immediate-merge vs gated-merge (wait until N tokens confirm). Might trade latency for stability. Also set a min instr-pass threshold in canary.

ops-bot: Shadow run completed: artifacts/shadow-2026-03-21.log uploaded to s3://rw-shadow/calypso/6167775432.log :white_check_mark:

Jun Park: For eval, let's use paired bootstrap to estimate the pass-rate delta CI, and also compute edit-distance on reference-critical tokens (e.g., code identifiers). We'll triage the open-ended set first.

Anika Bose: One more suggestion — try a softening schedule: when shim confidence > T, use top-2 sped path; otherwise, route to full. Tune T per prompt-type. Might recover most latency wins with <0.5pp quality hit.

Samir Patel: I'll run two follow-ups: (A) immediate vs gated KV merge, (B) confidence threshold sweep [0.6,0.7,0.8]. Aim to get paired A/B on the 5k open-ended bench by EOD Friday. Will post artifacts and a short notebook with examples.

Claire Ng: Thanks — add a canary gate for dedicated too (min instr-pass 88%) and a rollback policy if hallucination rate increases by >1pp. :+1:

Samir Patel: noted. Will also add a small qualitative set so reviewers can eyeball failure modes.

Jun Park: If you want, I can help instrument the edit-distance hooks and the bootstrap script.

Samir Patel: That would be great, thanks. Tagging you in the notebook when it's up. :rocket:
